title: flybot/01/brain/status
description: Brain program availability and sensor-input health, QoS 1, retained, on change + every 10 s. Last will is the offline form (only v, seq, up, st). Contract section 3.9.

seq.description: Per-sender, per-topic sequence number. 0 in the last-will message.

up.description: Sender uptime, ms. Uptime at connect in the last-will message.

tick.description: Mean compute time per control tick over last 10 s, ms (1 dp).

ovr.description: Ticks over the 50 ms budget in the last 10 s.

sens.description: Sensor input: ok = fresh; stale = newest sensors message older than 250 ms, brain silent on cmd/motor; none = no sensors message since start.

lag.description: Inbound messages received but not yet processed by the brain (queue length when this status was built).
